name: Terror by Night
source:
Hurry Watson! Get this movie-based game where YOU control the outcome! Type H for a HUNCH or T for THOUGHT (you can type lower case H or T). Sometimes you should go with your hunch, other times with your thought.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
华生快点！获取这款基于电影的游戏，你可以控制结果！键入H表示HUNCH，键入T表示THOUGHT（你可以键入小写H或T）。有时你应该跟随你的直觉，有时你应该跟随你的想法。

[来自Itch.io]
